records.title: Experience Compression Spectrum: Unifying Memory, Skills, and Rules in LLM Agents
records.reason: This paper synthesizes experience-compression levels across memory, skills, and rules and discusses transferability. It is a conceptual framework and cross-paper synthesis rather than a concrete method with measured savings.

records.title: Muon2: Boosting Muon via Adaptive Second-Moment Preconditioning
records.reason: Muon2 is an optimizer for large-scale foundation-model pretraining and the number/quality tradeoff of Newton-Schulz iterations. Its efficiency concerns training, not inference or serving.

records.title: Claw-Eval: Toward Trustworthy Evaluation of Autonomous Agents
records.reason: Claw-Eval is an autonomous-agent evaluation suite focused on trustworthy grading/safety, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Scaling and quantization of large-scale foundation model enables resource-efficient predictions in network biology
records.reason: The Nature publisher article could not be opened because the DOI redirected to an inaccessible institutional authorization page. The cached abstract claims quantization and resource-efficient network-biology prediction, but that is not a substitute for primary full-text review.

records.title: Thinking in Dynamics: How Multimodal Large Language Models Perceive, Track, and Reason Dynamics in Physical 4D World
records.reason: The work evaluates multimodal perception/tracking/reasoning of physical dynamics; it does not propose an LLM efficiency technique.
